title: Only one of us walked out of the mirror maze
description:
It was the last rainy weekend of the fair, and half the rides were already under tarps. My best friend Tasha wanted one more go in the mirror maze before it came down.

She walked out half a beat behind me. Every time.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: Would you have noticed she was always a little late?
